newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-INDIANS' RELIEF ACE MESA PLEADS INNOCENT TO RAPE.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-INDIANS' RELIEF ACE MESA PLEADS INNOCENT TO RAPE.

text.p: Cleveland Indians reliever Jose Mesa pleaded innocent Friday to a rape charge and four other felony charges relating to a December 22 incident.

Mesa, 30, the Indians' closer, also surrendered his passport, assistant Cuyahoga County Prosecutor Frank Gasper said in a telephone interview. Mesa lives in suburban Westlake but is a citizen of his native Dominican Republic.
Mesa was also charged with gross sexual imposition, felonious assault, theft and carrying a concealed weapon.
Police have said the charges stem from an incident in which two women told police they went to a local motel with Mesa and a friend of his, local businessman David Blanco.
Blanco, 34, pleaded innocent Friday to gross sexual imposition and carrying a concealed weapon.
The theft charge against Mesa involves one of the women's purses, police said.
